svg.title: TD Insurance CAT Contents Valuation BPMN Flow
svg.desc: BPMN flow with lanes for the licensed adjuster, Microsoft Copilot Studio, deterministic services, and governance. It includes a persistent claim-linked case store, retained inventory reuse, saved checkpoints, correction loops, deterministic valuation, mandatory human approval, and closure after external claim completion is confirmed.
svg.text: TD Insurance CAT Contents Valuation - BPMN 2.0 Draft
Recommendation mode | Deterministic financial calculations | Licensed adjuster approval required | MVP excludes claims-system write-back

text.tspan: Licensed adjuster retains authority for coverage interpretation, settlement,
payment, denial, filing, and customer communication.
